subject: Q3 GTM hiring: prioritization, offers & comp bands
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sarah Park <sarah@talentgroup.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 GTM hiring: prioritization, offers & comp bands

Hi Laura / Karthik,

Following our planning sync, attached is a formal headcount request for Q3 GTM hires and the recommended compensation bands. This is the proposal that we need leadership + finance sign-off on by EOD Monday (June 15) so recruiters can start offers and scheduling. High-level ask: authorize 7 total roles across Sales / CS / Solutions Engineering with the prioritization below.

Summary (requested):
- 3 x Account Executives (full-time) — priority 1
  - Proposed comp band (base): $120,000 - $150,000
  - Proposed OTE: $240,000 - $300,000
- 2 x Customer Success Managers (full-time) — priority 2
  - Band (base): $95,000 - $115,000
  - Target OTE (incl. renewals/expansion): $140,000 - $170,000
- 2 x Solutions Engineers (1 full-time, 1 contract-to-hire) — priority 3
  - Band (base FT): $140,000 - $165,000
  - Contractor rate (6mo): $75-90/hr depending on scope

Rationale: pipeline build for new mid-market vertical, enablement for newly launched integration, and coverage for renewal-heavy accounts in EMEA. The spreadsheet Q3_GTM_headcount_request.xlsx (attached) includes role-level hiring timeline, estimated ramp months, and fully-burdened cost per hire. I also attached comp_bands_2026.pdf which maps to our comp philosophy and market comps.

Requests:
1) Confirm headcount and bands (approve / tweak)
2) If approved, authorize recruiter outreach and verbal offers at midpoint while finalizing total comp letters
3) Finance: confirm FY budget run-rate impact (Aditya copied)

If you want to shave budget, my suggestion is shift 1 AE to 6-month IC instead of FT (retains revenue capacity but delays full run-rate).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Talent & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_GTM_headcount_request.xlsx (spreadsheet), comp_bands_2026.pdf (doc)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sarah Park <sarah@talentgroup.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 GTM hiring: prioritization, offers & comp bands

Marissa — thanks for the write-up and attachments. Quick thoughts: we should prioritize quota-carrying AEs to maximize ARR, but I wonder if we can reduce the AE base band to $110k-$140k and lean into accelerators to keep OTE competitive. That saves immediate run-rate and keeps total comp aligned to plan.

Also open to the idea of making 1 AE a 6-month contract-to-hire (agree with your suggestion) so we can accelerate coverage without committing full run-rate. For Solutions Engineering: can we hire 1 FT now and hold the second until we see post-launch integration demand (90-day check-in)?

I'll defer to Laura on final headcount, but fiscally I prefer 6 FTEs + 1 contractor as an acceptable compromise.

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 09:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message omitted)

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
SVP, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 GTM hiring: prioritization, offers & comp bands

Team — thanks for the thorough packet. I've reviewed the ask and the comps. Quick decision: I approve moving forward with six hires now rather than seven (so 3 AEs, 2 CSMs, 1 SE FT). Defer the second SE until we have a stronger read on integration-driven demand (review end of Q3).

Conditions:
- Finance needs to confirm the fully-burdened run-rate before offers go live (Aditya)
- AE comp: acceptable if we target base at the midpoint for offers and hold the top-end for exceptional candidates only
- We need offer language that includes a 90-day performance checkpoint for new hires (standard for ramp hires)

Please send me a one-page summary (total FTEs, incremental run-rate, expected ramp months) and I'll sign.

—
Laura Bennett
VP, Head of Commercial GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 GTM hiring: prioritization, offers & comp bands

Thanks — I pulled the numbers. Finance can support 6 FTEs for Q3 under the current hiring budget, contingent on the following:

1) Total fully-burdened annualized run-rate increase (if all 6 are onboarded) = $1,120,000 (includes benefits, equity accrual, and hiring costs). See attached headcount_runrate_q3.xlsx.
2) If we convert the 7th role to FT in Q3 the incremental run-rate is +$180,000 and would require reallocation or an uplift request to CFO.
3) We will approve offers at the midpoints you proposed. Any offer with base > midpoint needs CFO pre-approval.

Please return an updated one-pager with the final 6-role plan and the targeted base for each role (we'll validate against the spreadsheet). Once I sign off, you have finance approval to issue verbal offers and start background checks.

-Aditya

Attachment: headcount_runrate_q3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Park <sarah@talentgroup.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 GTM hiring: prioritization, offers & comp bands

Thanks all — summary below and next steps. Per Laura and Aditya, we will proceed with six hires (3 AE, 2 CSM, 1 SE FT) and hold the second SE. I captured adjusted comp guidance aligned to finance sign-off.

Approved plan (final):
- 3 x AEs (FT) — offer at midpoint: Base = $135,000; Target OTE = $270,000. Any base > $145k requires CFO approval.
- 2 x CSMs (FT) — offer at midpoint: Base = $105,000; Target OTE ~ $155k
- 1 x SE (FT) — offer at midpoint: Base = $152,500

Offer mechanics / recruiter notes:
- Verbal offers may be extended at midpoint pending background checks and references.
- Include 90-day performance checkpoint and standard equity language in offer letter.
- Greenhouse reqs to create today: REQ-2026-045 (AE), REQ-2026-046 (CSM), REQ-2026-047 (SE). Sarah — please prioritize candidate outreach for AE reqs; target first interviews by Jun 23.

Attachments: approved_headcount_summary.pdf (one-pager), updated offer template (internal) — stored in the doc link.

I'll send the finalized offer templates after I incorporate the CFO cap language. If there are urgent exceptions we can route via an expedited CFO approval.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Talent & GTM Operations
